svg.title: Two-bus CAN schematic with power chain: STM32F407, two TJA1051, ESP32

desc.style: fill:rgb(0, 0, 0);stroke:none;color:rgb(11, 11, 11);stroke-width:1px;stroke-linecap:butt;stroke-linejoin:miter;opacity:1;font-family:anthropic-sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:400;text-anchor:start;dominant-baseline:auto

svg.desc: U1 TJA1051 on CAN1 PB9/PB8 connects to the F-CAN bus. U4 TJA1051 on CAN2 PB6/PB5 connects to the separate B-CAN bus. OBD-II 12V passes fuse, TVS and Schottky diode to an LM22670 5V buck and an MCP1826 3.3V LDO. ESP32 runs from 3V3 and links to the STM32 by USART3, NRST and BOOT0.
